onet.title: Information Security Analysts
onet.description: Plan, implement, upgrade, or monitor security measures for the protection of computer networks and information. Assess system vulnerabilities for security risks and propose and implement risk mitigation strategies. May ensure appropriate security controls are in place that will safeguard digital files and vital electronic infrastructure. May respond to computer security breaches and viruses.

task.title: Develop plans to safeguard computer files against accidental or unauthorized modification, destruction, or disclosure and to meet emergency data processing needs.
Monitor current reports of computer viruses to determine when to update virus protection systems.
Encrypt data transmissions and erect firewalls to conceal confidential information as it is being transmitted and to keep out tainted digital transfers.
Perform risk assessments and execute tests of data processing system to ensure functioning of data processing activities and security measures.
Modify computer security files to incorporate new software, correct errors, or change individual access status.
Review violations of computer security procedures and discuss procedures with violators to ensure violations are not repeated.
Document computer security and emergency measures policies, procedures, and tests.
Confer with users to discuss issues such as computer data access needs, security violations, and programming changes.
Monitor use of data files and regulate access to safeguard information in computer files.
Coordinate implementation of computer system plan with establishment personnel and outside vendors.
Train users and promote security awareness to ensure system security and to improve server and network efficiency.

activity.title: Develop computer or information security policies or procedures.
Update knowledge about emerging industry or technology trends.
Implement security measures for computer or information systems.
Test computer system operations to ensure proper functioning.
Collaborate with others to resolve information technology issues.
Troubleshoot issues with computer applications or systems.
Coordinate project activities with other personnel or departments.
Monitor the security of digital information.
Train others in computer interface or software use.

element.name: Memorization

element.name: Number Facility

element.name: Control Precision

element.name: Hearing Sensitivity

element.name: Manual Dexterity

element.name: Response Orientation

element.name: Explosive Strength

element.name: Glare Sensitivity

element.name: Gross Body Equilibrium

element.name: Multilimb Coordination

trades.description: A Network Engineer builds and maintains the computer networks that connect offices, data centers, devices, and internet services. They install routers, switches, firewalls, and cables, set up secure connections, monitor traffic, and fix outages when systems slow down or fail. Their work keeps phones, apps, websites, and business systems running safely and reliably.

A Security Analyst protects an organization’s computer systems, networks, and data from cyber threats. They watch security alerts, investigate suspicious activity, test for weak spots, install or update protections, and help respond to breaches when something goes wrong. Their work helps keep information private, systems running, and online services safer to use.
